status.evidence: According to the UK Companies House registry, Redtail Telematics Limited (Company Number 07407204) is currently active.

claims.claim: The company reports that its core telematics platform achieves a 99.8% reporting health rate across more than 6 million devices deployed worldwide, delivering live fleet visibility, asset tracking, and device health timelines.
The company reports that its VAM-HDR quick-fit tracking device supports LTE Cat-M and NB-IoT cellular standards, alongside a standard 1 Hz GPS refresh rate and internal antennas.
claims.note: NB-IoT cellular standards and internal antennas

claims.claim: The company's Redtail Fleet platform and mobile applications provide native tracking capabilities, including driving behavior pattern analysis, a maintenance planning calendar, and 32 standard report templates, according to the Redtail Telematics platform specifications.

Redtail Telematics maintains an operational software integration with Route4Me to pair its telematics systems with route optimization, trip KPI dashboards, and driver behavior monitoring, as detailed in the Route4Me integration directory.
claims.corrected: Redtail Telematics does not maintain an operational software integration with Route4Me to pair its telematics systems with route optimization, trip KPI dashboards, and driver behavior monitoring, as detailed in the Route4Me integration directory.

claims.claim: The company reports its VAM onboard hardware device family, featuring the VAM-HUB pro-install flagship recorder, VAM-OBD plug-and-play unit, VAM-HDR quick-fit tracker, and IP67-rated solar-augmented VAM-Rugged, as detailed on the Redtail Telematics official product documentation.
claims.note: pro-install flagship recorder and quick-fit tracker descriptions

claims.claim: The company reports that its integrated Quality and Information Security Management Systems, which cover its data accuracy and security protocols for its telematics data, are officially certified under the ISO 27001 standard.

Redtail Telematics Limited provides ready-made telematics gateways and third-party integrations with route optimization and fleet logistics platforms, such as its active technical integration with Route4Me to automatically synchronize, import, and map operational vehicle and tracking data.
claims.note: The active technical integration status with Route4Me is unverified.

claims.claim: Redtail Telematics entered into a technical partnership agreement with Ford Motor Company in February 2022 to act as a reseller of connected vehicle data to motor insurers for both personal and commercial lines within the UK.
The company achieved a total annual turnover of £11.4 million alongside a two-year compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 61.11% as of March 2025, as published by the FEBE Growth 100 index.
claims.note: The exact CAGR figure of '61.11%' is unconfirmed; published index profiles report it as '61%'.

claims.claim: Redtail Telematics Limited signed an agreement with Ford Motor Company, announced in February 2022, to become a technical partner and reseller of connected vehicle data to motor insurers in both personal and commercial lines across the UK.

Redtail Telematics Limited partnered with UK motor insurer Admiral and Ford Smart Mobility to launch "Admiral Live", a connected car telematics insurance product that tracks driving data directly through the factory-installed FordPass Connect Modem.
The company announced it was ranked number 40 in The Sunday Times 100 Tech 2026 ranking.
The company reports its UK headquarters is located at the Plextek Building, Great Chesterford, Essex, providing weekday customer support from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.
Official registry filings from Companies House confirm that Redtail Telematics Limited is actively registered at the Great Chesterford facility with a recorded headcount of fewer than 50 employees.
